The structure of Nb2Cr4Ni4Ge8 (Nb(CrNiGe2)2) is tetragonal, space group I4/mmm (No. 139), with 18 atoms in the unit cell and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows Cr and Nb each in tetrahedral Ge environments, while Ni is eight-coordinate with four Ge and four Nb neighbors; Ge centers have eight geometric neighbors (Cr, Nb, Ni). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cr and Nb tetrahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Ge-centered 8-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions.
